goal: /api/search got about 4x slower after last week's release: p95 went from ~180ms to ~750ms. Find the cause and fix it.

messages.content: /api/search got about 4x slower after last week's release: p95 went from ~180ms to ~750ms. Find the cause and fix it.

content.text: Measuring the current state locally against a copy of production data first.

content.text: Fixed: tags are now eager-loaded in the search query (1 query instead of 51); p95 is back to ~164ms with the tags still in the response. Added a test that counts queries so the N+1 can't come back silently.

probes.fact: Baseline measured locally: p95 ~731ms at 20 connections
Suspect range: #897 (SearchService refactor) and #901 (tags in results)
The main search query uses its GIN index (~32ms): the index/archived_at change is ruled out
Each request runs 1 search query + 50 tag queries (N+1 from product.getTags())
Tags must stay in the response; the mobile app depends on them
Fix: eager-load tags with include in SearchRepository, no getTags() per product
After the fix: p95 ~164ms and a single query per request
